QuestInfo.name: [Phantom Forest] Ravens' Gratitude
QuestInfo.0: One of the Raven Ninja, Joko, has something to tell you. Go see what he wants.
QuestInfo.1: Joko says the Raven Ninja always always repay their debts, and mentions that he will reward you if you carry out requests for them in the future. Another of the ninja, Fiona, also has something to tell you about. Go speak with her.
QuestInfo.2: Fiona told you that she can craft Masteria Legacy items in the same fashion as Lireni once did. These relics are said to be artifacts that contain the power of the Grandmasters. Visit her with Shadowknight Coins to begin the process.

npc.0: Fiona said there was something she wanted to talk to you about, so go pay her a visit.
